title: Just Juice Fusion Blood Orange & Mango On Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: The newest Fusion flavour from vape legends Just Juice is a juicy cocktail of ripe tropical and citrus fruits. Fusion Blood Orange and Mango On Ice features punchy flavours of rich, zesty blood orange and sunny-sweet mango, layers of creamy passion fruit and tangy guava, and a little extra citrus edge. The cool, delicate rush of menthol on the exhale adds a refreshing top note to all that fantastic fruit and finishes this exquisitely fresh and vibrant e-liquid off to perfection. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
